question: What percentage of LAM customers consumed more than 46.73?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS denominator_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN y.Consumption > 46.73 THEN c.CustomerID END) AS qualifying_customers, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN y.Consumption > 46.73 THEN c.CustomerID END) AS DOUBLE) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID), 0) AS qualifying_percentage FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
